reason: I already threw away most of the PRs that background agents opened for us, and running them overnight just means I triage the junk in the morning. A pre-alpha tool from one developer won't change that, and I don't have time to draw flows and pair machines.
objection: Gates and tests don't make agent PRs good. I'd still spend my mornings reviewing and closing them, now with one more thing to maintain that could disappear when the solo dev moves on.
would_change_my_mind: Proof from a team like mine that most of the overnight PRs got merged without rework, and setup that takes under an hour.
